scope: 78 fixed zero-field baseline AMOEBA analyze EM programs; source and saved preparation only

findings.question: Zero-field charge-neutral C/P/B dipole redistribution at unchanged failed-science 17676 parameters; no model rescue or polarizability claim
findings.geometry_review: Independent saved script passed 2844 assertions: all 234 input hashes; literal coordinate/type/name tokens; remapped complete bonds; native O Bisector and H Z-then-X axes; positive masses; COM; and atomwise C/P/B permanent coefficient cancellation. No molecular programs imported or run.
findings.native_frame_reason: kmpole selects O axes through its two bonded H atoms and H axes through its bonded O and the other H via the same 1-3 path. Complete-water extraction and monotone atom renumbering preserve these assignments; metal permanent moment is charge +3 with zero higher multipoles.
findings.cancellation: C=full-ion-shell; P=sum(dimer)-N*ion-sum(water); B=full-sum(dimer)+(N-1)*ion-shell+sum(water). All parent atom/permanent-frame coefficient sums are exactly zero.
findings.units: SAVE-UINDUCE writes Debye to 6 decimals from uind; native moments writes COM-origin total dipole to 3 decimals. Corrected lab dipole adds 4.803206802*Q*COM_A. Induced sums are origin independent.
findings.roundoff: Weighted per-site 0.5e-6 Debye plus weighted 0.0005 Debye M printing and 2e-9 per weighted row COM allowance; these are print/conversion bounds, not induction-error bounds.
findings.native_readback: Require exactly 2 finite nonnegative induction summaries <=1e-8 Debye, all positive-alpha sites present once with exact ordered names, all finite components, saved energy replay <=1e-4 kcal/mol, component closure <=1e-6, and isolated ion zero checks.
findings.scope_and_failure: Only report keywords appended; immutable input checks and source/executable pins. Four single-thread workers on one four-CPU task; 78 reservation ceiling; global failure prevents further starts and preserves all slots, draining already running siblings. Full success and M consistency required before cycles are admitted.
findings.costs: Run records wall, parent CPU and one aggregate RUSAGE_CHILDREN delta; overlapping per-receipt child deltas are not summed. Scheduler accounting remains root-owned.
findings.author_controls: Read and verified 109 saved controls; did not rerun them. Actual preparation has zero native calls. First prose/apostrophe preparation failure and prior source are preserved.

limitations: This source review does not admit future native moments or show physical model accuracy.
